meta.name: audit-my-app
meta.description: Sweep a whole running web app for what is broken, without writing a script or knowing the codebase. Clicks every reachable control and reports dead buttons, console errors, failed requests, and places where the API and the screen disagree. Use on an unfamiliar codebase, before a release, after a big merge or dependency bump, when the user asks for a smoke test or a health check, or when someone says "just check everything still works".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍运行中的应用,列出点不动的按钮、控制台报错和接口对不上的地方。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在发版前、接手陌生项目或大改动后,想快速确认整站还能正常用。
copy.tagline_en: Sweep a running app and list dead buttons, console errors, and API mismatches.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to confirm a whole app still works before release or after big changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会驱动正在运行的 Web 应用,点遍所有可达控件,报告死按钮、控制台报错、失败请求,以及 API 与页面不一致的地方。
howto.when: 在陌生代码库上、发布前、大合并或升级依赖后等时机触发;当你说「看看是不是都还能用」,或要求做冒烟测试、健康检查时也会接管。

say.text: 扫描本地 dev 环境,点遍所有可达控件,最多 25 步。
say.note: 返回死控件、控制台报错等计数。

say.text: 比较 API 返回的数据和页面上实际渲染的内容。
say.note: 报告两者不一致的地方。

say.text: 看看哪些控件和已保存流程从没被跑过。
say.note: 给出未触及控件与无断言流程。

howto.what_en: Claude drives your running web app, clicks every reachable control, and reports dead controls, console errors, failed requests, and places where the API disagrees with the screen.
howto.when_en: Use on an unfamiliar codebase, before a release, after a big merge or dependency bump, or when you ask for a smoke test, a health check, or "just check everything still works".

say_en.text: Sweep the local dev app by clicking every reachable control, max 25 steps.
say_en.note: Returns dead-control, console-error and other counts.

say_en.text: Compare what the API returned against what the page rendered.
Show which controls and saved flows were never exercised.
say_en.note: Returns untouched controls and assertion-free flows.
